price_value.label: Price or value not justified
price_value.description: Too expensive for the value they saw, or a cheaper option was good enough.

budget.label: No budget or budget cut
budget.description: Money was not there or was taken away. Use no_decision instead if they simply stopped.

missing_capability.label: Missing feature or capability
missing_capability.description: A specific capability they needed that we lack. Name it in the quote.

integration_fit.label: Integration or technical fit
integration_fit.description: Did not fit their stack, data or workflow.

security_compliance.label: Security, legal or compliance blocker
security_compliance.description: SSO, data residency, a security review, contract terms.

competitor_strength.label: Competitor was a better fit
competitor_strength.description: The customer preferred a competitor's product or relationship. Set competitor.

implementation_effort.label: Implementation effort or time to value
implementation_effort.description: Rollout looked too slow, too hard or too resource-heavy.

trust_risk.label: Trust, risk or vendor viability
trust_risk.description: Doubts about us as a vendor: references, size, stability, past experience.

champion_change.label: Champion left or reorganisation
champion_change.description: Our sponsor or champion moved on, or the buying team changed.

no_decision_status_quo.label: No decision: stayed with the status quo
no_decision_status_quo.description: They kept what they had (spreadsheets, an incumbent, doing nothing).

no_decision_priority.label: No decision: timing or other priorities
no_decision_priority.description: Paused, deprioritised or pushed to a later period.

no_decision_authority.label: No decision: no sign-off
no_decision_authority.description: Could not get approval from the economic buyer or committee.

other_loss.label: Other loss reason
other_loss.description: A reason that fits nothing above; the quote carries the detail.

product_fit.label: Solved the core use case
product_fit.description: The product did the main job they bought it for.

ease_of_use.label: Ease of use
ease_of_use.description: Simpler to use or adopt than the alternatives.

integrations.label: Integrations
integrations.description: Worked with the tools and data they already have.

price_value.label: Price or value
price_value.description: Better price, packaging or ROI case.

security_compliance.label: Met security or compliance needs
security_compliance.description: Passed the review the alternatives did not.

support_relationship.label: Support and relationship
support_relationship.description: Responsiveness, trust in the team, references.

proof_trial.label: Successful trial or proof of concept
proof_trial.description: A pilot, trial or POC proved it.

other_win.label: Other win reason
other_win.description: A reason that fits nothing above; the quote carries the detail.

price_value.label: Price or value
price_value.description: Pushback on cost or ROI. A negotiation move (asking for a discount while still buying) is still logged here; note it in the quote.

competitive_comparison.label: Competitive comparison
competitive_comparison.description: Comparing us with a named competitor. Set competitor.

risk_trust.label: Risk or trust
risk_trust.description: Doubts about delivery, references or vendor stability.

status_quo.label: Status quo is good enough
status_quo.description: Current process or tool works well enough.

security_compliance.label: Security or compliance
security_compliance.description: SSO, data residency, security questionnaire, legal terms.

implementation_effort.label: Implementation effort
implementation_effort.description: Worry about rollout time or resources.
